label: Nature Location
description: Open landscapes and the roads through them — passes, coasts, forests, deserts and plains.

items.name: coastal-cliff-highway
items.text: A pristine, dark asphalt coastal highway carved into a sheer, granite cliffside, with the vast, open ocean on one side and rugged, salt-sprayed rocky outcrops on the other.

items.name: winding-coastal-road
items.text: A two-lane coastal road tracing the shoreline, weathered guardrail posts, wind-bent grasses on the bluff and sea spray hazing the rocks below.

items.name: great-ocean-road
items.text: The Great Ocean Road in Australia, with the iconic Twelve Apostles limestone sea stacks visible from the winding, guard-railed clifftop road.

items.name: white-sand-beach
items.text: A hard-packed lane of white beach sand along the waterline, crystal turquoise shallows on one side and soft dune grass combed by the wind on the other.

items.name: mirror-mountain-lake
items.text: A remote mountain lake at dead calm, snowy peaks and shoreline pines doubled without a ripple, a lone gravel spit reaching into the reflection.

items.name: florida-keys-causeway
items.text: A raised causeway road connecting islands in the Florida Keys, with the shimmering, shallow turquoise water of the gulf stretching for miles on both sides.

items.name: stelvio-pass
items.text: The serpentine Stelvio Pass in the Italian Alps, an intricate ribbon of worn asphalt with dozens of tight, numbered hairpin turns stacked closely together on a steep, scree-covered mountainside.

items.name: winding-mountain-road
items.text: A mountain road climbing through switchbacks between granite outcrops and scattered pines, gravel runouts and snow poles marking the verge.

items.name: black-forest-canopy
items.text: A road through the dense, dark Schwarzwald (Black Forest) in Germany, where towering fir trees create a dramatic, tunnel-like canopy over the asphalt.

items.name: gravel-rally-stage
items.text: A loose-gravel rally stage through dense pine forest, stones swept into pale berms on the outside of every corner, cut ruts through the apex soil and dust hanging between the trees.

items.name: autumn-foliage-road
items.text: A road drifted with fallen leaves at peak autumn color, maples and beeches in saturated red and gold arching over the centerline.

items.name: wooden-ravine-bridge
items.text: A lonely, weathered wooden bridge spanning a deep, forested ravine with a clear river flowing below.

items.name: endless-prairie-highway
items.text: A straight two-lane highway through open prairie, telegraph poles shrinking to the horizon and wind combing waves through the grass.

items.name: salt-flat
items.text: A vast, perfectly flat salt flat like the Salar de Uyuni, with a surface of dry, hexagonal cracked salt patterns stretching to an endless, clean horizon.

items.name: desert-highway
items.text: A dead-straight desert highway, heat shimmer melting the vanishing point, layered red mesas on the horizon and cracked earth beyond the shoulder.

items.name: lunar-landscape
items.text: A stark volcanic ash plain of overlapping craters and fine gray dust, boot-deep regolith running unmarked to a curved, airless-looking horizon.

items.name: fjord-aurora-dock
items.text: On a quiet wooden dock on a Norwegian fjord, with the shimmering green and purple curtains of the aurora borealis reflecting in the still, dark water.

items.name: vineyard-road
items.text: A lush vineyard road, rows of grapevines combing the rolling hills to the horizon.

items.name: foggy-rolling-hills
items.text: Rolling hills sunk in thick fog, hedgerows and lone trees fading into layered grey.

items.name: farmland-lane
items.text: A quiet farmland lane, a solitary farmhouse and silo on the distant field line.

items.name: valley-viaduct
items.text: A sky-high concrete viaduct spanning a forested valley, piers dropping away into the green below.

items.name: atlantic-ocean-road
items.text: The Atlantic Ocean Road in Norway, low causeways skipping between bare skerries and the cambered Storseisundet bridge arcing over cold green sea.

items.name: icelandic-lava-fields
items.text: An Icelandic ring-road stretch across black volcanic sand plains, moss-green lava fields and a glacier tongue descending between dark ridges.

items.name: redwood-corridor
items.text: A road threading between coast redwood trunks wider than the lane itself, fog drifting through shafts of filtered light far overhead.

items.name: red-rock-canyon
items.text: A desert canyon road between sheer red sandstone walls, dark streaks of desert varnish down the cliffs and a dry wash braiding alongside.

items.name: lavender-field-lane
items.text: A narrow Provençal lane between blooming lavender rows, purple furrows converging on a stone farmhouse and a lone umbrella pine.

items.name: savanna-acacia-plain
items.text: An East African savanna in golden grass, flat-topped acacias spaced to the horizon and a red laterite track cutting toward distant blue hills.

items.name: waterfall-gorge
items.text: A mossy basalt gorge behind a plunging waterfall, spray drifting through shafts of light and wet black stone glistening around the plunge pool.

items.name: glacier-lagoon
items.text: A glacier lagoon scattered with stranded icebergs, ridged blue-white ice drifting past banks of black volcanic sand toward the outlet.

items.name: moorland-single-track
items.text: A single-track moorland road with grass growing up the centreline, leaning passing-place posts, heather and peat hags rolling to a crag on the skyline.
